verses.text: This was Manasseh’s land share. He was Joseph’s firstborn. Machir, Manasseh’s firstborn and Gilead’s father, was a fighter, so he received Gilead and Bashan. ⚔️
The rest of Manasseh’s families also got their shares: Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These were the families of Manasseh son of Joseph. 👥
But Zelophehad son of Hepher, grandson of Gilead, great-grandson of Machir, and descendant of Manasseh had no sons—only daughters. Their names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. 👩‍👩‍👧

They came to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders. They said, ‘Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.’ So, as Yahweh commanded, Joshua gave them a share with their father’s brothers. 🗣️
Ten portions went to Manasseh, plus Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan. 🗺️
That’s because Manasseh’s daughters received an inheritance among his sons. Gilead went to the rest of Manasseh’s sons. 👥
Manasseh’s border ran from Asher to Michmethath, across from Shechem, then to the people of En-tappuah. 🗺️
The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah itself, on Manasseh’s border, belonged to Ephraim’s people. 🏘️

The border went south to the Kanah stream. Those towns belonged to Ephraim, even though they sat among Manasseh’s towns. Manasseh’s border ran along the north side of the stream and ended at the sea. 🌊
South of the line was Ephraim’s; north was Manasseh’s, with the sea as Manasseh’s border. Their land reached Asher on the north and Issachar on the east. 🗺️

Manasseh also had three highlands in Issachar. In Asher, they had Beth-shean and its towns, Ibleam and its towns, Dor’s people and towns, Endor’s people and towns, Taanach’s people and towns, and Megiddo’s people and towns. 🏘️
Still, Manasseh’s people couldn’t drive out the people living in those towns. The Canaanites kept living there. ⚠️
When Israel got stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but they never completely drove them out. ⚠️
Joseph’s descendants told Joshua, ‘Why did you give me only one land share? We’re a big people, since Yahweh has blessed us so much.’ 🗣️
Joshua answered, ‘If you’re such a big people, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves in the Perizzite and Rephaim country. Ephraim’s hill country is too small for you.’ 🌲

Joseph’s descendants said, ‘The hill country isn’t enough for us. And every Canaanite living in the valley has iron chariots—both the ones at Beth-shean and its towns, and the ones in the Jezreel Valley.’ 🛞
Joshua told Joseph’s family—Ephraim and Manasseh—‘You are a big people with real strength. You won’t be stuck with just one land share. 💪

‘The hill country will be yours. It may be forest right now, but clear it and the farthest reaches will belong to you. You’ll drive the Canaanites out, even though they have iron chariots and are strong.’ 🌲
